summary.en:
- [[character:hmc]] is a Super Break support capable of enabling allies to deal Super Break DMG.
- Their Ultimate grants all allies the Backup Dancer effect for three turns, increasing their Break Effect% and converting Toughness Reduction dealt to Weakness Broken enemies into an instance of Super Break DMG.
- The Super Break DMG triggered by Backup Dancer increases as the number of enemies on the field decreases.
- [[character:hmc]] remains a strong and free Super Break support unit.

details.en:
- E2 increases their own Energy Regeneration Rate% for 3 turns at the beginning of the combat, making it easier to get the first Ultimate.
- E4 is a team-wide Break Effect% boost. While only being 15% of their own Break Effect%, it is still a decent free increase for the team.
